facts.value: The BA program in American Studies at Goethe University focuses on the literature, culture, and history of the USA. It involves analyzing literary texts and non-literary cultural productions and media (such as film) as well as historical sources and discussing their various contemporary and historical significances.

Students acquire expertise about cross-cultural dimensions of American literatures, cultures, and American history and develop an understanding of interdisciplinary perspectives on their subject and various theoretical approaches and methods.
The program is divided into three focuses: American Literature and Literary Studies, American Culture and Cultural Studies, and American History and Society.

There is a traditional theater group (Chaincourt Theatre Company) and an annually published anthology of student texts, poems, and photographs (Student Anthology), both operated in close collaboration between educators and students.
These forms of extracurricular engagement provide students with the opportunity to gain initial practical experience in creative fields.
